answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring stake-backed identity: each agent locks collateral that is slashed on proven fraud, so spawning thousands of fake identities gets expensive fast. Reputation then accrues slowly through attested work, like wind shaping a dune grain by grain, while a hollow identity with no history earns no trust. Anchoring that record to a tamper-evident ledger, basalt-solid and append-only, lets anyone verify an agent before transacting, making cheap fakery uneconomical.
